---
title: "Eight Housing Affordability Myths"
date: "2014-07-10"
categories: ["Centre for Independent Studies", "Economics", "Foreign Investment", "House Prices"]
---

I have published a new Issue Analysis with the Centre for Independent Studies, [Eight Housing Affordability Myths](http://www.cis.org.au/images/stories/issue-analysis/ia146.pdf). In the paper, I show how a number of highly persistent myths about the nature of housing markets, the dynamics of house prices and the drivers of housing affordability condition public policy to focus on excessively on housing demand at the expense of housing supply.
